description: This file defines extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface in Orleans, specifically related to configuring fault injection for transaction testing and storage options in a distributed Orleans cluster.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class containing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to enable fault injection and transactional storage configuration in Orleans silos.

methods.name: UseControlledFaultInjectionTransactionState
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use the distributed transaction manager algorithm with fault injection.

methods.name: AddFaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage
methods.description: Adds fault injection support for Azure Table transactional state storage with default provider name.

methods.name: AddFaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage
methods.description: Adds fault injection support for Azure Table transactional state storage with specified provider name.
